headline: Executive order from 1996 concerning the Korean Peninsula Energy Development Organization, an international group tied to North Korea energy projects.
what_it_does: This order deals with the Korean Peninsula Energy Development Organization (KEDO), an international group formed in 1995 to supply energy, including nuclear power reactors and fuel oil, to North Korea under a 1994 nuclear deal. Orders like this one usually grant an international organization certain legal protections and privileges in the United States. No summary was provided, so the exact terms cannot be confirmed here.

who_it_affects.group: The Korean Peninsula Energy Development Organization and its staff
who_it_affects.how: The order likely sets out the group's legal status and protections when operating in the United States.

when_it_takes_effect: 1996-04-01 (date signed; exact effective date not stated in the source)
